gradeBands.label: Kindergarten
gradeBands.cue: Look closely. Point to what you see.

gradeBands.label: Grades 1–2
gradeBands.cue: Look closely, then tell a partner what you notice.

gradeBands.label: Grades 3–5
gradeBands.cue: Use details from the picture to support your idea.

gradeBands.label: Grades 6–8
gradeBands.cue: Explain your reasoning with evidence you can see.

gradeBands.label: Grades 9–10
gradeBands.cue: Ground your interpretation in specific visual evidence.

gradeBands.label: Grades 11–12
gradeBands.cue: Support your reading with evidence, and consider other readings.
